therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: omega-3 fatty acid incorporation into cell membranes with competitive inhibition of arachidonic acid-derived eicosanoids
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: neuroinflammation reduction and monoaminergic neurotransmission modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with multiple sclerosis and comorbid depression
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: 50% or greater improvement on the Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) from baseline to 3 months

subgroup_findings: SF-36 Physical Component Summary (PCS): fish oil +1.6 vs placebo -0.8
SF-36 Mental Component Summary (MCS): fish oil +1.5 vs placebo +4.2

dose_info.dose: 6 grams daily (2.1 g EPA + 1.5 g DHA)

context.indication: depression in patients with multiple sclerosis
